Behavior, state names (open/count/logs/isLoading/error/rules/vehicles/ruleMap/vehicleMap/hasLogs/showSpinner/display/triggerLabel), API path '/notifications/inbox', the { all: true } bulk mutation, the limit-10 preview, the 99+ badge clamp, severity mapping, and i18n keys/fallbacks are preserved. DOM-only concerns (createPortal, getBoundingClientRect coords + scroll/resize reposition, document mousedown/keydown, useId aria-labelledby, the querySelector focus trap, return-focus-on-close) are dropped and documented because RN <Modal> + the backdrop Pressable + onRequestClose provide the equivalent overlay/dismissal/focus behaviour. No DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.
